append_metrics.name: Optical transceiver market share (long-reach)
append_metrics.description: Estimated 2026 revenue share in long-reach/coherent optical transceiver market (TrendForce May 2026 report on optical transceiver supplier dynamics)

node_patches.append_notes: Public: NASDAQ COHR. Added round 4 to expand optical transceiver module supplier coverage from 2 to 4 (joining Lumentum, InnoLight, Eoptolink).

append_metrics.name: Supply-demand deficit
append_metrics.description: Global shipments 600k–700k wafers/year; demand 1.5–2M wafers/year. Zero inventory industry-wide. Order books extend 2027+. Source: Coherent CEO guidance, SemiAnalysis Q4 2025.

append_metrics.name: Market share (top-3)
append_metrics.description: JX Metals, Sumitomo, AXT control combined 80–90%. Source: SemiAnalysis InP supply chain, Q4 2025.

append_metrics.name: Capacity expansion lead time
append_metrics.description: JX's ¥1.5B investment for 20% capacity boost targeting end-FY2027 completion. Source: JX Metals announcement, 2025.

node_patches.append_notes: InP wafers are irreplaceable feedstock for 1310nm EML lasers used in coherent optical transceivers for AI datacenter interconnects. No silicon substitute. Alternative InP-on-GaAs emerging (Fraunhofer/III-V-Reclaim) but not yet commercial scale. Shortage directly gates optical transceiver production for 2026–2027 cycles.

append_metrics.name: Market share (T-glass globally)
append_metrics.description: Nittobo is the world's only qualified mass producer of T-glass. Asahi Kasei entering ~2026 but not yet HVM. Source: Nikkei Asia, Trendforce, DigiTimes 2025.

append_metrics.name: Supply deficit H2 2026
append_metrics.description: Tight supply expected to continue through 2026 as ABF substrate layer counts increase 3+3 → 13+13. Source: Morgan Stanley, Trendforce supply chain analysis, 2025.

append_metrics.name: Price increase schedule
append_metrics.description: Nittobo announced phased price hikes. Competitors (Asahi Kasei, Fulltech, Nan Ya) emerging but not in qualified high-volume status yet. Source: Nittobo press, SemiAnalysis, Aug–Dec 2025.

append_metrics.name: Capacity expansion roadmap
append_metrics.description: Nittobo targeting 3x T-glass capacity by early 2027, but new capacity largely pre-sold via long-term supply agreements. Source: DigiTimes, TrendForce 2025.

node_patches.append_notes: T-glass (boron-free, CTE ~3.5 ppm/K) is engineered for zero-warpage substrates in advanced packaging. Silicon-glass and E-glass are insufficient substitutes. Shortage is 100% Nittobo supply-gated, not demand-driven substitution. New entrants (Asahi, Nan Ya) targeting HVM entry 2026–2027 but qualification cycles are 12–24 months. Single-source corner expected to persist through 2026.

Additional supply base beyond the 5-org cap (concentration-first): Auras Technology (6288.TW), high-growth Taiwan thermal/CDU maker per DigiTimes 2026-04 AI-server thermal tracker; wired to thermal_management_module instead.
